# A deposit for exactly what the invoice is owed — the shape a bank feed
# leaves when the customer pays to the cent. Retargeting it settles the invoice
# with nothing left over, so the transaction ends up carrying one receivable
# split and no parked credit beside it.
2026-02-25 * "US Customer — payment for INV-USD-RETARGET"
  Assets:Bank:USD  100.00 USD
    memo: "Payment for INV-USD-RETARGET"
  Assets:Accounts Receivable USD  -100.00 USD
